_about: Where each summit_gps coordinate in mountains.csv comes from (Sept 2026). Values were read from search-result summaries of the cited pages; some are only to the nearest arc-minute (~1.8 km).

excluded.pangrango: Cited coordinate lands on Gede, not Pangrango.

semeru.note: Wikipedia infobox 08°06'28"S 112°55'19"E; input -8.108/112.922 agrees to 3 decimals.

raung.note: Wikipedia infobox highest point 8°07'30"S 114°02'30"E (3332 m). Seconds-level precision is coarse (30" steps).

argopuro.note: Wikipedia infobox 7°58'S 113°34'E (3088 m) is only minute precision (~1.8 km); treat as approximate for the Argopuro summit.

ijen.note: Input matches the GVP Ijen coordinate 8.058S 114.242E, but GVP states this refers to the approximate centre of the Kawah Ijen crater lake, NOT the 2799 m rim high point. Wikipedia's Ijen infobox 'highest point' (8°3'46"S 114°15'43"E = -8.0628, 114.2619) is Gunung Merapi, a different peak (see merapi-ungup). No cited coordinate for the Kawah Ijen rim summit found.

penanggungan.note: Wikipedia infobox 7°37'S 112°38'E (1653 m) is only minute precision (~1.8 km); treat as approximate.

butak.note: Indonesian Wikipedia: Gunung Butak at -7.922566, 112.451688, 2868 m (highest point of the Kawi massif).

liman.note: CAUTION: this is the Wikipedia Mount Wilis infobox coordinate 7°48'29"S 111°45'29"E listed with elevation 2563 m (= Liman/Puncak Trogati, highest point of the Wilis massif per id.wikipedia Gunung Liman). It appears to be the GVP volcano coordinate (7.808S 111.758E) and may be a massif reference point rather than the surveyed Liman summit. Verify before using as a hiking pin, or treat as null.

kelud.note: Wikipedia infobox 7°55'48"S 112°18'29"E (1731 m); volcano coordinate, likely crater area rather than a specific rim summit.

lemongan.note: Wikipedia infobox 7°58'44"S 113°20'31"E (Wikipedia lists 1641 m; input 1651 m).

merapi-ungup.note: Wikipedia Ijen infobox 'highest point' (Gunung Merapi, Ijen complex) 8°3'46"S 114°15'43"E; Wikipedia gives 2769 m vs input 2800 m.

merapi.note: Wikipedia infobox 07°32'29"S 110°26'46"E (2910 m); active summit dome changes shape.

slamet.note: Wikipedia infobox 7°14'21"S 109°13'12"E (Wikipedia lists 3432 m; input 3428 m).

prau.note: id.wikipedia infobox 7°11′13″S 109°55′22″E (2,590 m). Do NOT use the en.wikipedia 'Dieng Volcanic Complex' infobox value (7.3117, 109.9924) that appears under 'Prahu': it lies ~14 km SE, at Sindoro, not on the Prau ridge.

ungaran.note: GVP and en.wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Ungaran) both give only 7°11′S 110°20′E (arc-minute precision, roughly +/-1 km). No precise Puncak Botak summit coordinate was quotable from search results; replace it with a precise value if you can get one.

andong.note: Wikipedia gives 7°31′43″S 110°11′01″E (7.528520, 110.183650). Wikipedia lists the elevation as 1,463 m, against 1,726 m in the input. It is the same mountain (Magelang, between Ngablak and Grabag).

telomoyo.note: PeakVisor -7.361271, 110.399825 (1,894 m). This agrees with the GVP/Wikipedia value of 7.37S 110.40E (low precision).

sikunir.note: PeakVisor 'Gunung Sikunir' -7.238385, 109.924722 (2,258 m), which is next to Sembungan village. The input elevation of 2,463 m looks wrong: local sources (id.wikipedia Bukit_Sikunir, Wonosobo tourism office) give about 2,263 m. The coordinate came from a search-result summary, not from the page itself.

gede.note: Wikipedia 6°47′S 106°59′E (arc-minute precision, +/-1 km). GVP Gede-Pangrango gives the same point, 6.78S 106.98E. No precise summit-rim coordinate was found.

papandayan.note: Wikipedia 7°19′S 107°44′E (GVP gives 7.32S 107.73E). Low precision: this is roughly the active crater, not necessarily the 2,665 m summit (Tegal Alun area). No precise summit coordinate was found.

cikuray.note: Wikidata/ceb.wikipedia 7°19′21.00″S 107°51′35.64″E. English Wikipedia has no article.

burangrang.note: Wikidata/ceb.wikipedia 6°44′07″S 107°35′05″E. This figure comes from the GEOnet Names Server, so it is a named-feature point rather than a surveyed summit.

sibayak.note: Wikipedia 3°14′21″N 98°30′20″E (north of the equator, so the latitude is positive).

dempo.note: Wikipedia 4°00′57″S 103°07′42″E. Wikipedia gives the elevation as 3,142 m; the input says 3,173 m, the common figure.

tambora.note: LOW PRECISION, verify before use. Wikipedia and GVP give only 8°15′S 118°0′E, which is roughly the caldera centre. The caldera is about 6 km across, so this point is NOT the hikeable rim summit. No precise rim-summit coordinate was found.

bawakaraeng.note: Wikidata 5°19′12″S 119°56′24″E. English Wikipedia has no infobox coordinate. This lies about 3 km N of Lompobattang, which is consistent with the massif.
